name: DOKI DOKI HYPNOTISE CLUB
source:
A fan game for Doki Doki Literature Club, where you must hypnotize all the four girls from DDLC.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241103140413/https://renai.us/game/ddhc]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
